name: Do I need permits for aging-in-place renovations in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for aging-in-place renovations in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many aging-in-place renovations in Las Vegas and surrounding areas may require permits, especially for structural changes, significant plumbing or electrical work, or adding permanent ramps. Minor cosmetic changes generally do not. It's crucial to obtain the necessary permits to ensure work meets local building codes and safety standards. As your general contractor, Simply Construction will handle the permit application process for all required work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many aging-in-place renovations, especially structural, plumbing, or electrical work, require permits in the Las Vegas area. Your contractor handles this process.
